title: Permission matrix
description: Roles, what each role may do through ledgerbot, and the users mapped to roles with their channel addresses. Host roles are mapped onto this matrix by the host; ledgerbot enforces it on every message and API call.

capabilities.description: Capability names or globs: "*", "query_*", "record_collection". See GET /v1/capabilities.

channels.description: Channels this role may use; empty = all. API calls are not restricted by channel.

save_mode.description: Can only tighten the company save mode.

scope.description: own: the role can only approve/see its own drafts.

addresses.description: Channel address per channel kind. WhatsApp addresses (wuzapi/waba) are E.164 phone numbers and shared between both kinds.
